infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Firewatch uses Bluetooth to talk to your Meshtastic radio, so fire alerts reach you with no cell signal.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Firewatch uses your location only while the app is open, to show how far fires and neighbor reports are from you, and to add your spot to a report you send.
